notes: Registry of ROM byte-ranges the converter will extract at stage s01.
Populate 'regions' with (name, offset, length, kind) records.
Never commit any bytes here. Just the metadata (offsets, lengths).
'offset' and 'length' accept 0xNNN hex strings or plain integers.
'kind' is informational: bma | bpc | bpa | kao | ssb | text | table.
